experiment: cpu scaling, one package, memory interleaved over all 4 nodes
ramp_note: thread i -> node (i//8)%4: threads 1-32 fill the four nodes' physical cores 8 at a time, 33-64 add their SMT siblings in the same node order
prog_bw_note: prog_gbps is what bandwidth.c computes from the bytes it asked for. In write mode DRAM moves about twice that (RFO + writeback); dram_gbps is the measured controller traffic.
